raw: {"approved":false,"notes":"The curated surface mostly covers the primary story, but I would not approve it as-is. Concrete issues: apps/geckoterminal/src/tool.rs:450-494 defines geckoterminal_get_pool_ohlcv without the API's token parameter and then passes token=[REDACTED_SECRET] while the description says it returns the pool's base-token candles. That is unsafe for token/pair analysis because if the user's target asset is the quote token, the chart/trend is inverted or simply the wrong side of the pool; it also lacks before_timestamp, so historical windowed analysis is limited. apps/geckoterminal/src/tool.rs:511-539 has the same omission for geckoterminal_get_pool_trades: the API supports token='base'/'quote'/address to invert trade perspective, but the tool always passes None. Recent trades can therefore report buy/sell direction and amounts from the wrong token perspective. apps/geckoterminal/src/lib.rs:27 advertises solana/non-EVM network IDs and the app claims 200+ networks, but apps/geckoterminal/src/lib.rs:58 registers only namespaces=[\"evm-core\"]; if namespaces affect app routing/eligibility, this undercuts the across-networks story. Lower severity: list/page/limit/address batch inputs are not clamped to documented API maxima, so the model can generate avoidable API errors instead of safe bounded calls."}
